Nuevo Laredo is stepping up patrols and prevention points for Halloween on Saturday, October 31, 2026, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo.

The municipal government is coordinating the operation with municipal agencies and authorities from other levels of government, with the goal of protecting families moving through the city on Halloween night.

Tránsito y Vialidad, the Guardia Municipal, and Protección Civil y Bomberos are among the participating agencies, according to the report.

Strategic surveillance points include Doctor Mier y Guerrero, Guerrero y Héroe de Nacataz, and the rotonda del Infonavit area. Units will also make intermittent patrols in different sectors depending on mobility conditions, according to El Mañana.

Humberto Fernández Diez de Pinos, director of Protección Civil y Bomberos, is the official named in the report. The mayor's instruction, as reported, is to redouble and reinforce preventive actions, with bulletins and recommendations published daily on the Protección Civil y Bomberos and municipal government pages.

For pedestrians, the advice includes walking on sidewalks, wearing reflective items, keeping children by the hand, avoiding crossing mid-block, and crossing at corners with caution. For drivers, the advice includes obeying traffic rules, not driving under the influence of alcohol, and not using a cell phone while driving.

Emergency numbers given in the report are 911 and Protección Civil y Bomberos at 712-8911, 712-2124, and 712-3030.

Sources:

  • El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, "Halloween 2026 en Nuevo Laredo: implementan puntos estratégicos de prevención este 31 de octubre," October 26, 2026
